correctness.rationale: The rank hyperplane <1,x>=0, <r,x>=-1 has codimension two by connected rank function and Numata dimension theorem. Orthogonal projection of zero is -r/S; |e_v-e_w|²=2 gives R²=2-1/S. All edge vectors are vertices. A common sphere is minimum exactly when its center lies in the vertex convex hull. Nonnegative incidence flow of divergence -r/S has total mass one automatically; network cut constraints on lower ideals give necessity and sufficiency. An explicit graded five-vertex DAG violates the condition with R²=23/14. All N≥3 and rank normalization checked; finite tests are corroborative only.
